payload.description:
Two follow-ons to the Claude spot worker (spotticus-16bdd0):

1. A set of deliberately cheap dummy spot chores that exercise the whole dispatch loop end to end without burning meaningful CPU or tokens, so the machinery can be tested repeatedly.
2. A second dispatch path where Spotticus drives Claude Code in-process via the Claude Agent SDK instead of shelling out to the CLI.

The SDK path is worth having because it gives Spotticus things the CLI wrapper cannot get: a real turn limit (max_turns), a message stream it can watch and stop mid-run, and in-process control of the lock rather than a trap-and-signal dance.
payload.title: Cheap dummy spot routines and an SDK-style dispatch path
